source.text:
6 April 2026
Oakhurst Mutual Insurance
Our reference: CP959001

Dear Kathleen,

Your home insurance policy HP-94396907 is due for renewal on 6 May 2026. Your new annual premium will be £192.14, which includes insurance premium tax.

If you are happy to renew, you need do nothing: cover will continue automatically and the premium will be collected from your usual account on 6 May 2026.

If you would like to change your cover or not renew, tell us before 6 May 2026. After that date the new policy year will have begun.

Your excess remains £43.65 for all claims except escape of water, where it is £192.14.

Kind regards,
Lydia Johnson
Oakhurst Mutual Insurance
